description: Resource deployment manifest for ThoughtMachine — documents every file that bootstrap.py deploys from resources/ (and the repo root) to the user's ~/.thoughtmachine/ directory. The vault's docker/resource/ build files are AUTHORITATIVE for resource-image auto-builds (see infra/resource_container_manager.py).

files.description: Default system prompt for agent mode
System factory defaults — immutable base configuration for the vault; deployed to the system/ subdirectory
Factory default CheckSystem allowlist — initial allowlist for the CheckSystem tool
Agent configuration overlay (diff from factory defaults — merged with resources/default_config.json at load time)
System prompt for the engineer/architect agent role

Unified runtime Dockerfile — single source for both the executor image and the tm-resource-git resource image — deployed to the vault (~/.thoughtmachine/docker/resource/) where it is AUTHORITATIVE for auto-builds; agent-write-blocked; never overwritten once present
Git overlay Dockerfile (ARG BASE_IMAGE + FROM ${BASE_IMAGE} + apt git/ca-certificates/curl) — stage 2 of the resource-image build; vault copy is authoritative; never overwritten once present
Pinned Python requirements for the resource runtime image — sourced from the repository root; vault copy is authoritative; never overwritten once present

directories.description: Worker role templates (only default.json is deployed)

notes: Global knowledge base (resources/global_kb/*.md → ~/.thoughtmachine/knowledge/system/) is handled separately by agent/knowledge/global_kb.py::ensure_global_kb()
User subdirectory structure (~/.thoughtmachine/sessions/, state/, knowledge/) is created by bootstrap.py::ensure_user_defaults()
This manifest is the single source of truth for resource deployment. The RESOURCE_MAP dict in bootstrap.py is derived from this file.

The vault's docker/resource/ directory holds 3 authoritative build files (default_runtime.Dockerfile, git_overlay.Dockerfile, requirements.txt), all never_overwrite. A legacy vault copy at docker/resource/Dockerfile (pre-provenance layout) is promoted into default_runtime.Dockerfile on bootstrap.
